title: The sandbox credentials probe behind the guide's evidence lives only in a scratchpad
body:
The harness probe behind the sleeve-agents guide's credentials paragraph exists only in dc's scratchpad and hv's `~/mac`: `kovacs-creds.sh`, 114 lines of `sh`, which builds a scratch HOME holding placeholder credential files, a scratch `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and an ops-shaped project whose settings deny them, runs the real Claude Code against it from a plain terminal in three arms (A: `Read()` denies plus `sandbox.credentials.files`, as ops and docs ship; B: `sandbox.credentials.files` alone; B2: B plus paths the WP06 floor's patterns do not match), and cleans up, login token included. Its results for Claude Code 2.1.308 on kovacs (22 Oct 2026) and the Seatbelt run on rhadamanth (21 Oct) are in `docs/guides/sleeve-agents.md`. Nothing in the repo can re-prove them after a Claude Code upgrade.

## Ruling (hv, 22 Oct 2026): keep it in Molt as a manual probe

dc moves the script to `test/manual/sandbox-creds.sh`, host-neutral: no sleeve name in a path or a comment that is not an example, the role it shapes taken from an argument or an environment variable with `ops` as the default. `bats -r test` does not run it (it is `.sh`, not `.bats`) and it must stay that way; it runs only by hand, from a plain terminal, never inside a Claude session, and its header says so and says what each arm proves. Clean under `shellcheck -s sh`. The guide's sandbox and credentials section names it as the way to re-run the test, and `CHANGELOG.md` takes an Added line. Branch `issue-0036`.
